title: TEPA prototype participation terms
disclosures: A participation unit records a contractual economic claim under prototype terms. It is not a legal share and gives no voting, board, or operating rights.
The fictional issuer may have no distributable cash. Distributions can be zero and are not guaranteed.
Units are illiquid. Direct investor-to-investor transfers are restricted at contract level. No buyback is promised.
The initial unit price is separate from any later informational valuation estimate. An estimate is not cash or a withdrawal right.
Wallet loss, software defects, testnet outages, and incorrect or reversed chain events can disrupt this demonstration.
Prototype only. Fictional issuer and investors. No real securities are offered, no real money is accepted, and testnet tokens have no financial value.
